events.title: COVID-19 demand shock
events.detail: Travel and economic activity fell sharply, cutting fuel demand and creating extreme oil-market volatility.

events.title: Russia invades Ukraine
events.detail: The invasion and sanctions disrupted global energy trade and increased uncertainty around supply.

events.title: OPEC+ announces additional cuts
events.detail: Major producers announced voluntary output cuts, tightening expected supply.

events.title: Iran conflict escalates
events.detail: Conflict raised risks to Middle East production and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Saudi East-West pipeline attacked
events.detail: A major Saudi export route was disrupted, increasing concern about crude supply and shipping capacity.

events.title: Yanbu loadings disrupted
events.detail: Reduced loadings increased concern about available replacement crude supplies.
